messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "increase by 500 mg increments weekly"
set: ["increase by 500 mg increments weekly", "increase in 500 mg increments weekly based on glycemic control and tolerability", "increase by 850 mg every 2 weeks", "increase dosage by 25 mg every 3 days", "increase dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.25 mg", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on current dose", "increase total daily dose by 50 mg every 3 days as tolerated", "increase by 2.5 mg to 5 mg per day at 1 to 2 week intervals", "weekly (injection)", "once weekly", "daily dose may be raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "daily dose may be raised in 10 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on current dose for Type 2 Diabetes", "reduce dose to 1.7 mg once weekly", "increase dosage to 1 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.5 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "increase dosage to 2 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 1 mg if additional glycemic control is needed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
